tasks: Learn
Read Part 1 of the crash course (the money language: revenue, costs, profit, cash).
You can explain the difference between profit and cash in your own words.
Money
Choose ONE bank account for the business only. Open a new one if needed.
Every client payment from now on goes into that account.
Money
Download bank statements from 1 April 2025 to today (the 2025/26 and 2026/27 tax years).
PDF or Excel statements saved in one folder.
Tool
Fill in the Setup sheet: business name, opening balances, categories, accounts.
Setup sheet complete; no yellow cells left empty that apply to you.
Tool
Enter every transaction for April–June 2026 from the bank statements into the Transactions sheet.
Closing balance on the Cash Flow sheet for June matches the bank statement.
Learn
Read Part 2: how bookkeeping works (categories, the cash book, receipts).
You know which category every common expense goes into.
Money
Start a receipt habit: photograph every receipt into one phone album or folder named by month.
This week's receipts are all saved.
Tool
Enter July–September 2026 transactions.
September closing balance matches the bank.
Tool
List every client on the Clients sheet and every unpaid invoice on the Invoices sheet.
You know exactly who owes you money and how much.
People
Shortlist 3 accountants (CA Sri Lanka or AAT Sri Lanka members, or a tax practitioner) and book short meetings.
Meetings booked.
Legal
Get a TIN from the IRD e-Services portal if you don't already have one. It becomes compulsory for key transactions from 1 November 2026.
TIN certificate saved.
Legal
Check your business registration: sole proprietor or partnership (Divisional Secretariat) or company (Registrar of Companies, eROC).
You have the registration certificate, or know what to register.
People
Hire an accountant. Ask about the 2025/26 return (due 30 Nov), the 15 Nov instalment, WHT certificates, VAT and SSCL.
Accountant engaged; tax deadlines confirmed in writing.
Money
Start the 10-minute daily routine (enter yesterday's transactions, file receipts).
Done at least 5 days this week.
Tool
Close October: enter everything, match the bank, update invoice payments.
October closing cash on the Cash Flow sheet matches the bank to the rupee.
Learn
Read the Monthly P&L for April–October and write down 5 things you notice.
5 observations written (best month, biggest cost, margin trend…).
Money
Set a fixed monthly owner salary and a tax reserve %. Open a separate savings account for tax.
Owner pay and tax % entered on Setup; first transfer to tax savings made.
Tool
Fill in the Service Pricing sheet for every service you sell.
You know the real profit and effective hourly rate of each service.
Strategy
Check client concentration: what % of revenue comes from your biggest client and your top 3?
Risk written down; if one client is above 30%, you have a plan to win more.
Learn
Read Part 4: pricing and unit economics.
You can say which service to push and which to fix or drop.
Customers
Interview your 5 best clients using the questions in Part 5.
Notes from 5 conversations, with their exact words.
Strategy
Write your Ideal Client Profile (who they are, what problem they have, why they choose you).
One paragraph you could give to a salesperson.
Legal
Pay the 2nd income tax instalment for 2026/27 by 15 November (with your accountant).
Payment made and receipt saved; recorded as Income Tax Paid.
Strategy
Write the One-Page Business Plan (Part 5 template).
One page, finished, read aloud to a partner or friend.
Strategy
Set 3 measurable goals for January–March 2027.
Each goal has a number and a date.
Tool
Fill in the Forecast sheet for October 2026–March 2027 and set a monthly budget for fixed costs.
Forecast done; October actual vs forecast reviewed.
Legal
Make sure the 2025/26 income tax return is filed by 30 November.
Filing confirmation saved.
Tool
Close November books.
November cash matches the bank; P&L reviewed.
Marketing
Write your positioning statement and one-line pitch (Part 6 template).
You can say what you do, for whom, and why you're different in one sentence.
Marketing
Fix the brand basics: consistent name and logo, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn/Facebook page, WhatsApp Business profile.
All profiles match and show how to contact you.
Marketing
Choose 1–2 marketing channels and plan 4 weeks of activity.
A dated content or outreach plan for January.
Sales
Start the Sales Pipeline sheet: every enquiry and lead goes in it.
All current leads entered with a next action and date.
Sales
Ask your 5 happiest clients for a referral or testimonial.
At least 2 testimonials or referrals received.
Operations
Write SOPs (step-by-step checklists) for the 3 tasks you repeat most.
3 SOPs that someone else could follow.
People
Draw the org chart: every role, who does it now, and what to hire or outsource next.
Hiring/outsourcing list with priorities and budget.
Operations
Fix your management rhythm: daily 10 minutes, weekly 30-minute review, monthly close, quarterly plan. Put them in your calendar.
Recurring calendar events created.
Tool
Review the Dashboard: revenue, margins, cash, overdue invoices, runway.
You can explain every number on it.
Tool
Close December and review the full quarter (October–December).
Quarter review written: what worked, what didn't, numbers vs forecast.
Strategy
Write the Q1 2027 plan: 3 priorities, goals, budget, who does what.
Plan agreed with partners/team.
Legal
Estimate the 3rd tax instalment (due 15 Feb 2027) with your accountant.
Amount known and saved in the tax account.
